task_language: Pick the akita black bowl on the stove and place it on the plate
strategy_notes: Localized the target semantically in agentview_high as the patterned akita bowl sitting on the gray stove cook region, rejecting the identical bowl on the cabinet; agentview back_project samples on the stove bowl gave a rough anchor around x=-0.178,y=-0.107. The destination was the red-ring white plate, with agentview back_project samples around x=0.093,y=0.176. Winning sequence: reset to a clean episode, rotate_wrist delta_yaw=+1.57 with gripper open, explicitly move_to the stove-bowl anchor at [-0.185,-0.105,1.12] while preserving yaw, run pi0_pick('pick up the bowl on the stove', max_chunks=16, lift_thresh=0.05, gripper_closed_thresh=0.06), accept the grasp despite pi0_pick.success=false because wrist/agentview showed the correct bowl held and the gripper gap was nonzero, set_gripper +1 for 8 steps, lift with move_pose to [-0.275,-0.095,1.10] at yaw +1.57, carry via [-0.08,0.08,1.10] to [0.08,0.235,1.095], descend to [0.065,0.235,1.015], apply a small left/back correction to [0.045,0.205,1.015], then release(max_steps=80). The release fired the official predicate after 8 steps.
